course.name: 30-Day Web Development Internship
course.description: A comprehensive 30-day web development internship program built from reusable technology modules.

architecture.hierarchy: CAREER PROGRAM → PHASE → MODULE → TOPICS → LESSONS → QUIZ → PRACTICAL TASK → ASSIGNMENT → PROJECT

phases.title: Web Foundation
phases.description: Core web development fundamentals covering HTML, CSS, and version control

learning_outcomes: Write programs using variables, data types, and operators
Implement control structures (conditions and loops)
Work with arrays and objects for data storage
Create and use functions with parameters and return values
Apply error handling and debugging techniques
Solve basic algorithmic problems
Create semantic HTML5 document structure
Use HTML5 elements for text, links, images, and multimedia
Build accessible forms with validation
Implement semantic elements for better SEO and accessibility
Use HTML5 APIs for enhanced functionality
Create SEO-friendly web pages
Apply CSS selectors and specificity rules
Style with colors, typography, and box model
Implement layouts with Flexbox and CSS Grid
Create responsive designs with media queries
Add animations and transitions
Use CSS variables and component-based styling
Initialize and manage Git repositories
Use branching and merging strategies
Resolve merge conflicts
Collaborate using GitHub pull requests and issues
Implement Git workflows for team development
Use GitHub for code review and releases

phases.title: JavaScript & Frontend Framework
phases.description: Modern JavaScript and React.js for building interactive user interfaces

learning_outcomes: Master JavaScript fundamentals and ES6+ features
Manipulate the DOM and handle events
Work with arrays, objects, and JSON data
Implement asynchronous programming with promises and async/await
Integrate with APIs using Fetch
Organize code with modules and follow best practices
Build React applications with functional components and hooks
Manage state with useState, useEffect, and context
Implement client-side routing with React Router
Integrate REST APIs with error handling and loading states
Optimize performance with React Query and code splitting
Build scalable component architectures with Redux Toolkit

phases.title: Backend, Database & Integration
phases.description: Server-side development, database management, and full-stack integration

learning_outcomes: Build server-side applications with Node.js
Work with file system, streams, and events
Create REST APIs with Express-like routing
Implement error handling and logging
Work with environment variables and configuration
Follow Node.js security best practices
Build production REST APIs with Express.js
Implement middleware for authentication and validation
Structure APIs with controllers and services
Handle file uploads and downloads
Document APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger
Follow REST API design best practices
Design normalized database schemas with ER diagrams
Write complex SQL queries with joins and subqueries
Implement transactions and concurrency control
Create indexes for query optimization
Work with stored procedures and functions
Design database relationships and constraints
Implement secure password storage with hashing and salting
Create JWT-based authentication systems
Manage user sessions and cookies securely
Implement role-based access control (RBAC)
Integrate third-party authentication (OAuth, Google Login)
Apply authentication security best practices
Build full-stack applications with React and Node.js
Implement RESTful API communication between frontend and backend
Manage application state with React hooks and context
Implement secure authentication and authorization flows
Handle file uploads and form validation
Integrate databases with proper error handling

phases.title: Capstone Project & Portfolio
phases.description: Final capstone project demonstrating all skills learned

learning_outcomes: Deploy production application
Present portfolio
